items.title: Novo sues Lilly after alleged misleading and false advertising campaign
items.summary: In a lawsuit filed in the US, Novo alleged that Lilly’s campaign was designed to mislead consumers on “comparative efficacy” of drug brands.

items.title: Why Japan is a global destination for regenerative medicine
items.summary: Japan is becoming a regenerative medicine hub, with ageing patients, clear regulations, universal insurance data, and globally aligned trial reforms.

items.title: Five considerations for adopting AI in clinical study build workflows
items.summary: AI can accelerate study-build foundations, but only when teams combine targeted automation with standards, traceability and control.

items.title: AAIC26: Alzheimer’s disease heterogeneity calls for a rethink
items.summary: While the Alzheimer’s disease care landscape is shifting, gaps to widespread therapeutic availability and imaging remain, said experts at AAIC 2026.

items.title: Novartis Q2 profits recover as revenue mantle passes to newer medicines
items.summary: Novartis continues to navigate a decisive period as newer portfolio assets start to offset patent pressures.
